plugins.description: 11 Claude skills for day trading US stocks and crypto: scan thousands of charts, track breaking news, time every entry and exit, and replay every outcome before you risk a dollar. Crypto pairs such as BTC-USDT trade 24/7 on Binance's public prices (or Coinbase's), with paper fees. Paper trading only.
